[LSCO.2.5.1] DS is deterministic under fixed inputs (per
[LDET]), fully testable (per
[LTES]), and fully debuggable (per
[LDEB]). These are operational
affordances — "I can understand what my rules are doing, and
I can prove they still do it after I change them." For a
policy engine whose rules are the configuration, these are
not luxuries; they're what makes the whole exercise
sustainable.
